newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy hard left confident budget will be equitable.
newsitem.headline: Italy hard left confident budget will be equitable.

text.p: The leader of the hard-left Communist Refoundation said he was confident the 1997 budget, which is due to be unveiled on Friday, would be equitable.
Fausto Bertinotti, who has bitterly opposed Treasury plans to cut health and pensions spending, told reporters that earlier budget talks with government allies had made a "significant step forward".
"Even if there continue to be problems, we have made a significant step forward," Bertinotti told reporters after the government summit.

Minutes earlier Foreign Trade Minister Augusto Fantozzi said the budget, which will be presented to the cabinet on Friday, would cut 50 trillion lire from next year's deficit and include savings of four trillion lire on health and pensions spending.

"Naturally until we have crossed the finishing line, and we will cross the finishing line tomorrow evening with the presentation of the budget, there will continue to be problems," Bertinotti said outside the prime minister's office. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
